title: Ottawa Hot Air
specs: Largest fleet of special shape hot air balloons in the world, with 15+ balloons
Pilots are Transport Canada certified with over 75 years combined experience
Flight area near Ottawa offers views of city, forest, farmland, wetlands, and mountain ranges
Weight limits: max combined 350 lbs for 2 passengers, 650 lbs for 3 or 4 passengers
Not suitable for infants, children under 8 years, pregnant women, recent scuba divers, people with chronic pain or recent major surgery
Passengers must be able to stand during flight and climb in/out of basket
Flight training students must be Canadian citizens or permanent residents, at least 16 years old
Flights are private and personal, with only 2, 3 or 4 passengers per balloon

blurb: Guests experience private hot air balloon flights lasting 45 minutes to an hour, with total experience time of 3-4 hours including check-in, transportation, inflation, flight, and pack-up. Flights operate near Ottawa, Ontario, with views of city, forest, farmland, wetlands, and distant mountain ranges depending on conditions. The company also provides balloon flight training and operates the largest fleet of special shape hot air balloons worldwide.
extraNote: Prices do not include 13% HST and $30 online booking fee · Require 72 hours notice for cancellation or schedule changes · Flights only operate in suitable weather: light winds, no rain, snow or fog; rescheduling allowed if weather unsuitable · Launch location about 45 minutes east of Ottawa; exact location provided after booking. · Three seasons: Summer and Autumn on select weekdays; other seasons not fully stated.
